title: Results on the postsingular set of compositions of transcendental entire functions
summary: In this paper, we study the dynamics of commuting transcendental entire functions $f$ and $g$, where $g=af^p+b$ with $a,b\in\mathbb{C}$, $p\in\mathbb{N}$, and $a\neq 0,1$. We examine how singular values and postsingular sets behave under composition. Within this framework, we show that if one of the functions is postsingularly finite (respectively, postsingularly bounded, hyperbolic), then the other function also has this property, and so do their compositions.
